# opstracer_escalation_policy (Resource)

An OpsTracer escalation policy: ordered levels of responders paged until someone acknowledges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_user" "lead" {
  email = "lead@example.com"
}

resource "opstracer_escalation_policy" "backend" {
  name        = "Backend"
  description = "Page the backend on-call, then the lead"
  is_default  = true

  levels = [
    {
      timeout_seconds = 600
      targets         = [{ type = "schedule", schedule_id = opstracer_schedule.backend.id }]
    },
    {
      targets = [{ type = "user", user_id = data.opstracer_user.lead.id }]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `levels` (Attributes List) Escalation levels, paged in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--levels))
- `name` (String) Policy name.

### Optional

- `ack_timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds an acknowledgement lasts before the alert re-pages. Server default when unset.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the org default policy, used when no routing rule matches. The org always has exactly one default, so `true` takes it over from the current default. `false` is accepted only while another policy is the default: to move the default, set `true` on the new policy and leave this unset here.
- `repage_after_ack` (Boolean) Whether to page again once the acknowledgement times out. Server default when unset.
- `repeat_count` (Number) Times to repeat the whole policy when nobody acknowledges. Server default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID.

<a id="nestedatt--levels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `levels`

Required:

- `targets` (Attributes List) Who to page at this level. All targets are paged together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--levels--targets))

Optional:

- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait for an ack before moving to the next level. Server default is 300.

<a id="nestedatt--levels--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `levels.targets`

Required:

- `type` (String) `user` or `schedule`.

Optional:

- `schedule_id` (String) Schedule whose on-call user is paged. Required when `type` is `schedule`.
- `user_id` (String) User to page. Required when `type` is `user`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_escalation_policy.backend <escalation-policy-id>
```
